proofs.algebraic_proof: Let M=2^64-1,p=x&1. Replace x&~1=x-p, x|~1=M-1+p, ~(x&~1)=M-x+p, ~(x|~1)=1-p, ~x&~1=M-1-x+p. Coefficients: x=12+6-17=1,p=19-12-11-6-7+17=0,M=-11-6+17=0,const=11+7-17=1. Therefore x+1 modulo2^64. Solver timeout unknown is not used as proof.
